notes: A202943_main: for Aq in Q[[X]] with Aq^3 = B = sum C(n+2,2) 2^(n(n-1)) x^n and constant term 1 (the entry's definition), every coefficient is an integer z with Odd z iff n = e + 32m, e in {0,1,2,3,8,9,10,11}, m with base-4 digits 0/1 (A000695). Route: integer cube root built coefficientwise (Aint_cube; division by 3 exact since b(m) = C(m+2,2) and [x^m]A^3 = C(m+2,2)-3 mod 9), cube_root_unique; parity from B = 1+x mod 2, A^4 = A(1+x), coeff_sq, recursion a(n) = a(n-1) + [4|n]a(n/4). Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: reading of A000695 as base-4 digits in {0,1}; b-file agreement (certificate/check.py).
